charts.title: Task 06: Latency Optimization via Persistent MCP Server Pool (N=30)
charts.sample_size: N=30 (steady-state pipeline latency); N=1 (one-time pool startup/shutdown)
metrics: In-Process Baseline Mean Latency: 0.94 ms (P95: 1.02 ms, N=30)

Persistent Pool 1-Time Startup Overhead: 9490.23 ms (single observation)
Persistent Pool 1-Time Shutdown Overhead: 1458.25 ms (single observation)
Speedup Factor: ~304.3x reduction relative to Task 06 process-per-call measurement
charts.notes: Steady-state persistent MCP sessions avoid per-call subprocess spawns, reducing MCP overhead to stdio JSON-RPC communication and orchestration overhead, excluding repeated subprocess startup. Note: The Task 06 process-per-call measurement (11,489.28 ms) was obtained from a separate evaluation suite and is reported separately from the Task 05 benchmark (9,586.15 ms).
